patches_modified.name: Add ability to copy media link
patches_modified.description: Adds "Copy media link" to the post menu: the direct links of the post's photos, videos and GIFs.

patches_modified.name: Custom download folder
patches_modified.description: Saves downloaded photos and videos to a folder of your choice instead of Download/X.

patches_modified.name: Custom share menu
patches_modified.description: Hides options from the post menu.

patches_modified.name: Custom sharing domain
patches_modified.description: Shares and copies links with another domain, such as fxtwitter.com, in place of x.com.

patches_modified.name: Customize Inline action Bar items
patches_modified.description: Hides actions from the bar under each post.

patches_modified.name: Customize Navigation Bar items
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from the bottom navigation bar. Home always stays.

patches_modified.name: Customize default reply sorting
patches_modified.description: Sets the sort replies open with.

patches_modified.name: Customize explore tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from the Explore page.

patches_modified.name: Customize notification tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from Notifications. At least one tab always stays.

patches_modified.name: Customize search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides kinds of suggestion from the search box.

patches_modified.name: Customize search tab items
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from search results. At least one tab always stays.

patches_modified.name: Customize side bar items
patches_modified.description: Hides rows from the side bar.

patches_modified.name: Customize timeline top bar
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from the top of the home timeline. At least one tab always stays.

patches_modified.name: Delete from database
patches_modified.description: Adds options to the Morphe settings to delete cached promoted entries or clear cached timelines.

patches_modified.name: Disable auto timeline scroll on launch
patches_modified.description: Opens the home timelines where you left them, instead of at the newest posts.

patches_modified.name: Enable Undo Posts
patches_modified.description: Holds each post for a few seconds before sending it, so it can be undone.

patches_modified.name: Enable debug menu for posts
patches_modified.description: Adds "Post data" to the post menu: everything the app knows about the post, as text.

patches_modified.name: Enable force HD videos
patches_modified.description: Always plays videos at the highest quality the device supports, whatever the connection.

patches_modified.name: Feed filters
patches_modified.description: Adds feed filters to timelines: media only (images, videos, GIFs), hide followed profiles, and include/exclude keyword filtering. Toggle each filter from the Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Filter posts by keyword
patches_modified.description: Hides posts whose text contains any of your keywords, ignoring case. Edit the keywords from "Filtered keywords" in any post's menu, or in the Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Force enable translate
patches_modified.description: Offers to translate every post, not only those the server marks translatable.

patches_modified.name: Handle custom twitter links
patches_modified.description: Opens links to other X frontends, such as fxtwitter and vxtwitter, in the app. They have to be enabled under "Open by default" in the app's system settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide Banner
patches_modified.description: Hides the "See new posts" pill at the top of the timeline.

patches_modified.name: Hide Community Notes
patches_modified.description: Hides Community Notes under posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide FAB
patches_modified.description: Hides the floating Post button.

patches_modified.name: Hide badges from navigation bar icons
patches_modified.description: Hides the unread counts and dots on the bottom navigation bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide promote button
patches_modified.description: Hides the Boost button on your posts and the Boost item in their menu.

patches_modified.name: Hook feature flag
patches_modified.description: Overrides the app's feature switches with values chosen when patching.

patches_modified.name: Import/Export login token
patches_modified.description: Adds Export login and Import login to the Morphe settings, opened from the app icon's shortcuts. An export holds everything needed to use your account.

patches_modified.name: Legacy share links
patches_modified.description: Shares posts as x.com/<username>/status/<id> rather than x.com/i/status/<id>.

patches_modified.name: Native downloader
patches_modified.description: Lets every photo, video and GIF be saved from its long-press menu and the media viewer, without a watermark.

patches_modified.name: Native reader mode
patches_modified.description: Adds "Reader mode" to the post menu: the post's text, selectable, with links to its media.

patches_modified.name: Native translator
patches_modified.description: Adds "Translate with Google" to the post menu.

patches_modified.name: No shortened URL
patches_modified.description: Opens links in posts at their real address instead of through t.co.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ads
patches_modified.description: Removes promoted posts, accounts and trends from timelines.

patches_modified.name: Remove premium upsell
patches_modified.description: Removes Premium upsells: the Upgrade button on the home timeline, the Premium side bar row, and the Get verified cards and prompts.

patches_modified.name: Share Tweet as Image
patches_modified.description: Adds "Share as image" to the share sheet of a post, which shares it as an image card.

patches_modified.name: Show poll results
patches_modified.description: Shows the results of polls without voting. Polls cannot be voted on while this is applied.

patches_modified.name: Show sensitive media
patches_modified.description: Shows media marked sensitive without blurring it behind a warning.

patches_modified.name: Support external downloader
patches_modified.description: Adds "Open in downloader" to the post menu, which shares the post's link with an app of your choice.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium checks
patches_modified.description: Makes the app's own Premium subscription checks always pass. Features the server enforces still need a subscription.

patches_modified.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes Microsoft OneDS/Aria lifecycle, aggregated-metric and failure-logging dispatch methods, stubs Singular attribution SDK initializers and dispatchers, nullifies ad measurement platform identifiers (AIFA, AppSetId), rewrites default telemetry endpoints inside telemetry packages and custom blocked hosts unscoped to 0.0.0.0, disables cross-sell, Floodgate, HockeyApp and DataTransport components, and strips advertising and preinstall attribution permissions.
patches_modified.previous_description: Neutralizes Microsoft OneDS/Aria lifecycle, aggregated-metric and failure-logging dispatch methods, nullifies ad measurement platform identifiers (AIFA, AppSetId), rewrites default telemetry endpoints inside telemetry packages and custom blocked hosts unscoped to 0.0.0.0, disables cross-sell, Floodgate, HockeyApp and DataTransport components, and strips advertising permissions.

patches_modified.name: Bypass Code Transparency
patches_modified.description: Skips the code-transparency failure dialog and reports local verification success, unblocking sideloaded installs.

patches_modified.name: Copilot Companion Native Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips optional companion native binaries (React Native, Hermes, SlimCV) via in-situ zeroing. WARNING: Hermes and React Native are load-bearing for React Native initialization - enabling this WILL crash Copilot React Native surfaces (Copilot chat host) with UnsatisfiedLinkError. The HockeyApp native exception handler (proven UnsatisfiedLinkError in OfficeApplication.onMAMCreate) and voice/dictation SDKs (libofficevoicesdk, libofficevoicetranscriptionsdk; proven dlopen FATAL on boot path) are load-bearing at startup and are therefore never stripped.

patches_modified.name: Disable Login Requirement
patches_modified.description: Removes login requirement and FTUX paywall screens. Cloud-backed features still require sign-in server-side.

patches_modified.name: Ambient light
patches_modified.description: Fills the black bars around the video with a soft glow of the picture's colours, like Ambient light for YouTube. Configurable in Settings > Video and audio > Ambient light.

patches_modified.name: Danmaku comments
patches_modified.description: Flows regular comments, live chat, and chat replays over videos like NicoNico/bilibili, with native in-app settings, NG words, and no API key.

patches_modified.name: Auto-translate Reddit content
patches_modified.description: Automatically invokes Reddit's existing post and comment translation path.

patches_added.name: Auto claim mission rewards
patches_added.description: Claims completed My missions rewards and draws their lotteries in the background, without the reward popup or the lottery animation, and shows a short message with the result.

patches_added.name: AMOLED black
patches_added.description: Makes Kick's dark background pure black for OLED screens, optionally with near-black cards and sheets. Starts off. Choose it in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Background audio
patches_added.description: Keeps live streams and videos playing as audio when you leave Kick, using Kick's own audio notification. A second switch turns off the automatic picture-in-picture window. On by default, as on Twitch. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Block update prompts
patches_added.description: Stops Kick from asking for or forcing an app update. A patched Kick can't be updated from Google Play, so update by patching a newer version. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Default startup tab
patches_added.description: Adds a choice of the screen Kick opens on instead of Home: Browse or Following. Links and notifications still open what they point to. Starts on Home. Choose another in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Don't save searches
patches_added.description: Stops Kick from saving what you search for on this device. Searches you saved earlier stay until you remove them. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Privacy.

patches_added.name: Hide Home sections
patches_added.description: Hides the featured carousel, recommended streams and categories rows on Home, each with its own switch. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Hide chat highlights
patches_added.description: Hides pinned messages, polls and predictions, goals, sub and gift messages, host messages, reward redemptions, event and drops banners, pinned KICKs gifts and celebration prompts, each with its own switch. Other chat messages are unchanged. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Hide rating prompt
patches_added.description: Stops Kick from asking you to rate the app. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Normal latency
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that turns off low-latency mode for live streams: a few seconds more delay, fewer rebuffers on weak connections. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Seek interval
patches_added.description: Sets how far the rewind and forward buttons skip in videos and rewound live streams: 5, 15, 20 or 30 seconds instead of 10. Starts at Kick's 10 seconds. Choose another in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Show deleted messages
patches_added.description: Keeps chat messages that moderators delete, or remove with a timeout or ban, struck through with a (Deleted), (Timed out) or (Banned) label, the way Kick's chat shows them to moderators, along with its ban, timeout and unban lines. Large KICKs gifts in chat also get the moderators' menu, whose Delete is meant for the channel's moderators. A second switch keeps the chat when a moderator clears it. Both on by default, as on Twitch. Turn them off in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_added.name: Sleep timer
patches_added.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, including background audio. Starts off. Choose a time in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Stay on channel when it hosts
patches_added.description: When the channel you're watching hosts another one, Kick's host dialog waits for you instead of switching when its countdown ends: Watch now still switches, Cancel stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Third-party emotes
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that shows the channel's 7TV emotes, and 7TV's global emotes, in live chat. When on, it sends the channel owner's Kick user ID to 7tv.io and loads emote images from cdn.7tv.app. Not in the emote picker or autocomplete. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Sets the default adaptive quality ceiling to the selected height when that rendition exists. Kick can still choose a lower quality. The player's Auto option uses this ceiling. A lower starting ceiling can be set for mobile data in Lurk settings > Playback; it's off until then.
patches_modified.previous_description: Sets the default adaptive quality ceiling to the selected height when that rendition exists. Kick can still choose a lower quality. The player's Auto option uses this ceiling.

patches_added.name: Block update prompts
patches_added.description: Stops the "update required" screen and the "new version available" dialog that Rumble turns on remotely, so a patched version keeps working when Rumble raises its minimum version. Update by patching a newer version. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Chat keywords
patches_added.description: Highlights live chat messages that mention you or contain your highlight words with a tinted background, optionally with a vibration, and hides messages with blocked words or from blocked users. Mentions are on by default; the word and user lists start empty. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_added.name: Chat timestamps
patches_added.description: Shows the time each live chat message was sent in front of the sender's name. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_added.name: Default startup tab
patches_added.description: Opens Rumble on Home or My Feed every time, instead of the one you last chose. Starts off. Choose a tab in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Don't save searches
patches_added.description: Stops Rumble from keeping your searches on the phone and hides the ones it kept, so they no longer show under the search box. Suggestions still come from Rumble's server as you type. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Privacy.

patches_added.name: Fill screen
patches_added.description: Zooms videos to fill the screen in landscape, cropping the edges instead of showing black bars, on phones taller than 16:9. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Hide Create tab
patches_added.description: Removes the Create (camera and upload) button from the bottom bar. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Hide Home sections
patches_added.description: Hides Home's categories, creators and playlists rows, each with its own switch, and any section whose title you list in Lurk settings, such as Live or Rumble Originals. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Hide chat clutter
patches_added.description: Hides pinned messages, raid and gift notices and sponsor reads in live chat, each with its own switch, and optionally chat badges or the whole chat. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_added.name: Keep playing during other sounds
patches_added.description: Choose whether Rumble pauses when another app plays sound: always (Rumble's behavior), only for longer interruptions, or never. Calls still pause playback. Starts off. Choose it in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Keep screen on while paused
patches_added.description: Keeps the screen on while a video is paused in the player, as it is during playback. When the video ends or you leave the player, the screen can turn off again. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Refresh stream
patches_added.description: When a video or live stream fails, tap the error screen to reload it at the same point. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Remember playback speed
patches_added.description: Keeps the playback speed you last picked for every video, including after Rumble restarts, instead of going back to 1x. Live streams without rewind still play at 1x. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Resume videos when signed out
patches_added.description: Starts videos where you left off when you aren't signed in, from the positions Rumble already keeps on the phone. Signed in, Rumble's own watch progress is unchanged. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Seek interval
patches_added.description: Sets how far the player's rewind and forward buttons skip, instead of 15 seconds. Starts off. Choose it in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Show deleted messages
patches_added.description: Shows the text of live chat messages that moderators remove, or that Rumble hides because the sender was muted, after Rumble's "Message was removed by moderator" label. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_added.name: Show exact counts
patches_added.description: Shows view, like, comment, follower and "watching now" counts in full (12,345 instead of 12K). Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Sleep timer
patches_added.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, including background play and picture-in-picture. Starts off. Choose a time in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Starts videos at the chosen quality, or the closest one available, instead of 480p. Once you pick a quality in the player, Rumble keeps using that one. Starting live streams at it too, and a lower cap on mobile data, are separate settings that start off. On by default. Change it in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Hide chat clutter

patches_added.name: Keep playing during other sounds

patches_added.name: Keep screen on while paused
patches_added.description: Keeps the screen on while a video is paused in the player, as it is during playback. When the video ends or you leave the player, the screen can turn off again. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Refresh stream
patches_added.description: When a video or live stream fails, tap the error screen to reload it at the same point. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Remember playback speed
patches_added.description: Keeps the playback speed you last picked for every video, including after Rumble restarts, instead of going back to 1x. Live streams without rewind still play at 1x. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Resume videos when signed out
patches_added.description: Starts videos where you left off when you aren't signed in, from the positions Rumble already keeps on the phone. Signed in, Rumble's own watch progress is unchanged. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Seek interval
patches_added.description: Sets how far the player's rewind and forward buttons skip, instead of 15 seconds. Starts off. Choose it in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Show deleted messages
patches_added.description: Shows the text of live chat messages that moderators remove, or that Rumble hides because the sender was muted, after Rumble's "Message was removed by moderator" label. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_added.name: Show exact counts
patches_added.description: Shows view, like, comment, follower and "watching now" counts in full (12,345 instead of 12K). Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Sleep timer
patches_added.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, including background play and picture-in-picture. Starts off. Choose a time in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Crash of Cars Anti-hacking Check
patches_modified.description: Stops the game's built-in tamper detector from flagging the app as modified. The game ships a native check that fingerprints classes.dex and quietly marks the app as not genuine whenever the fingerprint does not match the one it was built with — which is exactly what happens the moment any mod is applied, since changing the app inevitably changes that fingerprint. With this on, the game keeps reporting itself as a normal, unmodified install, so purchases and other store features are not silently suppressed.

patches_modified.name: Crash of Cars Free IAP
patches_modified.description: Every store item — coin packs, gem bundles, remove ads and the starter bundles — is granted the instant you tap Buy, and no Google Play payment sheet ever opens. Because nothing is fetched from Play, purchases work fully offline with no Play account, and remove-ads stays unlocked across restarts since the entitlement is re-delivered from a fake owned-purchases list at every launch.

patches_modified.name: Crash of Cars Instant Ad Rewards
patches_modified.description: Turns every "watch a video" offer into an instant payout. Coins, gems and boosters that the game offers in exchange for sitting through a rewarded advert are credited the moment you tap, with no video to play, no countdown and no waiting — and the offer stays repeatable afterwards, so you can claim it as often as you like. Works with no internet connection and the reward stays credited after restarting the game.

patches_modified.name: Crash of Cars No Ads
patches_modified.description: Removes the full-screen advert that plays at the end of every race, so the results screen comes up straight away instead of behind an ad you have to sit through or skip. The race still finishes normally — the game is told the advert opened and closed exactly as it would have been, so nothing gets stuck waiting for it. Works offline and survives restarts, because no part of the ad display depends on a network round trip.

patches_modified.name: Crash of Cars Sideload / APK Expansion Bypass
patches_modified.description: IMPORTANT: this patch only removes the licensing gate — it does NOT supply the game data. The 153 MB expansion file must already be on your device before the game will start. Copy main.<versionCode>.com.notdoppler.crashofcars.obb into Android/obb/com.notdoppler.crashofcars/ (on most phones that is the internal Android/obb folder, not the one on the SD card) using a file manager or an ADB push. If the file is missing or in the wrong place the game will still stall on the loading screen no matter what this patch does. Aside from that: lets the game start from a sideloaded APK instead of a Google Play install. The downloader refuses to use the expansion file even when it is present because Play's licensing server rejects a re-signed package, so the game stops on "Download failed because you may not have purchased this app" before it ever reaches the menu. This forces the expansion downloader past both gates: it always reports success instead of a stale or unlicensed error, and it always takes the licensed path when Play answers. The expansion data is still md5-verified file by file exactly as shipped, so a genuinely incomplete or corrupt download is still reported rather than silently ignored.
